tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search Jobven job postings with the filters of GET /v1/public/jobs. Returns 10 jobs by default (at most 25) with a plain-text excerpt of each description; get_job has the full text. Pass nextCursor back as cursor, with the same filters, for the next page. Each job returned counts toward the monthly

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: One Jobven job posting by id, with the full description (GET /v1/public/jobs/{id}). Counts as one job toward the monthly allowance.

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Find employers Jobven collects jobs from by name (GET /v1/public/companies). Returns id, name and website; get_company has the profile. Free: company searches do not count toward the allowance.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: One employer's profile by id (GET /v1/public/company-profiles/{id}): what it does, industry, size, founding year, headquarters and social links. Counts as one toward the monthly allowance.

tools.name: webhook_example
tools.description: A sample Jobven webhook delivery for one event: the raw body and headers exactly as a receiver gets them, signed with an example secret, plus the signature verifier from the webhook docs in TypeScript, Python or Go. The verifier accepts the sample, so a receiver can be tested end to end. No API call

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "webhook_example" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_companies" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search the employers Jobven collects jobs from (GET /v1/public/companies). Free: company searches do not count toward the allowance." → after: "Find employers Jobven collects jobs from by name (GET /v1/public/companies). Returns id, name and website; get_company has the profile. Free: company searches do not count toward the allowance."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
